name: Commercial & Personal Lines North Star
description: Rationalize four legacy product models into canonical commercial & personal lines product models — common core, segment and geography variations made explicit, dead constructs retired.
northstar: One canonical product model per major line; variation as parameterized exception, never a fork.

components.name: Party & role master
components.principle: One party model; roles as typed links

components.name: Coverage catalog
components.principle: Perils and endorsements as catalog entries

components.name: Rating parameters
components.principle: Rates and floors as settings, never code

microservices.techStack: Canonical product model · JSON schema + rules DSL

microservices.name: Personal Lines North Star
microservices.techStack: Canonical product model · rate tables as config
